content.title: Canes To Face Senators In Round 1 Of 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs | Carolina Hurricanes
content.text: Skip to Main Content Canes To Face Senators In Round 1 Of 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs Schedule to be released later this week By Peter Dewar & Walt Ruff Hurricanes.com April 14, 2026 Link copied RALEIGH, N.C. - The 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs kick off this weekend, and the Carolina Hurricanes now know their first-round foe. With the top seed in the Eastern Conference locked down, the Canes will take on the second Wild Card slot, claimed by the Ottawa Senators. Carolina went 2-1-0 against the Senators this season, scoring three or more goals in each contest. This will be the first-ever playoff meeting between the Hurricanes and Senators. Playoff Tickets Available NowTickets for Round 1 of the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs are on sale now! Secure your seat in the Loudest House today. Buy TicketsSuite Rentals 2025-26 Regular Season Meetings... January 24: Nine Hurricanes registered a point as a hot start helped Carolina top the Sens 4-2 in Ottawa. February 3: Sebastian Aho had three points and Seth Jarvis notched two goals as the Canes took a 4-3 victory at Lenovo Center. April 5: Carolina struck first, but three consecutive goals in the final 40 minutes lifted the Senators to a 6-3 win at Canadian Tire Centre.
